name: bareium-mcp
stderr:
bareium-mcp is a reserved name and does not contain the Bareium MCP server.

The server is published as @bareium/mcp. Confusingly, the command it
installs is also called bareium-mcp — it is the package name that differs:

    npx -y @bareium/mcp

In an MCP client config, the command is "npx" with args ["-y", "@bareium/mcp"].
See https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bareium/mcp
